nodes.summary: For every sequence $(a_n)_{n \ge 0}$ of real numbers there is an infinitely differentiable function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ whose derivatives at $0$ are $f^{(n)}(0) = a_n$ for every $n \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Borel's lemma

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space, let $n \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$ and let $a \le b \le c$ be real numbers. Let $f, g : \mathbb{R} \to E$ be such that $f$ is $C^n$ on $[a, b]$ and $g$ is $C^n$ on $[b, c]$, and suppose that for every natural number $k \le n$ the $k$-th derivative of $f$ within $[a, b]$ and the $k$-th derivative of $g$ within $[b, c]$ agree at $b$. nodes.title: Gluing $C^n$ functions on adjacent closed intervals

nodes.summary: Let $F : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be given by $F(x) = x^2 \sin(1/x^2)$ for $x \ne 0$ and $F(0) = 0$. Then $F$ is differentiable at every real $x$, but its derivative $F'$ is not Lebesgue integrable on $[-1,1]$.
nodes.title: The derivative of $x^2 \sin(1/x^2)$ exists everywhere but is not integrable

nodes.summary: Let $a>0$ and let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be twice continuously differentiable on $[-a,a]$ with $f(x)=f(-x)$ for all $x\in[-a,a]$. Then there is $g : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, continuously differentiable on $[0,a^2]$, with $f(x)=g(x^2)$ for all $x\in[-a,a]$.
nodes.title: An even $C^2$ function is a $C^1$ function of $x^2$

nodes.summary: There is a nondecreasing function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ that is differentiable at every point and whose derivative $f'$ is not continuous.
nodes.title: A monotone differentiable function with discontinuous derivative

nodes.summary: A smooth function on the unit interval with some vanishing derivative at each point is a polynomial there. Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be infinitely differentiable on $[0, 1]$, and suppose that for every $x \in [0, 1]$ there is an integer $n \ge 0$ such that the $n$-th derivative of $f$ within $[0, 1]$ vanishes at $x$ (at the endpoints these derivatives are one-sided). nodes.title: A smooth function on the unit interval with some vanishing derivative at each point is a polynomial there

nodes.summary: There is exactly one real number $x$ such that $e^{x-1} - e^{1-x} = x$.
nodes.title: The map $x \mapsto e^{x-1} - e^{1-x}$ has a unique fixed point

nodes.summary: For every odd positive integer $n$, the polynomial $1+x+x^2/2!+\cdots+x^n/n!$ has exactly one real zero.
nodes.title: Odd Taylor polynomials of the exponential have exactly one real zero

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
